headline: Healthcare Customer Service Representative
summary: Registered nurse and former clinic assistant now working in healthcare customer service. After two years coordinating patients in a Masbate clinic, I joined a US healthcare account where I help patients by phone and email with appointments, prescriptions and insurance questions. My clinical background helps me understand callers quickly.

projects.name: Clinic patient reminder system
projects.description: Set up text and call reminders for follow-up appointments at the clinic, which cut missed visits by about a third.

projects.name: Medical terms quick guide
bullets: Wrote a two-page guide to common medical terms and abbreviations for new agents.
Now part of the account's onboarding materials.

experience.title: Healthcare Customer Service Representative
bullets: Help US patients by phone and email with appointment scheduling, prescription refills and coverage questions.
Document each contact accurately in the provider's customer relationship management software.
Recognise urgent symptoms in calls and route them to the nurse line right away.

experience.title: Clinic Assistant
bullets: Took patient histories and vital signs and prepared charts for the physicians.
Scheduled patients and coordinated referrals to the provincial hospital.

education.school: Masbate Island College of Health Sciences
notes: Registered Nurse, Philippine Nurse Licensure Examination, 2022
